scope: One separately profiled 8B/S512 training step per backend; kernel work, NOT wall latency
caveats: Both paths have the same collective counts; this does not establish equal wire throughput
NCCL kernels include synchronization/waiting and may overlap computation
Larger summed NCCL duration does not imply slower end-to-end training
Extra custom local work is consistent with recomputation/data handling; this is not an isolated causal ablation
Do not add kernel work to predict wall-clock speedup
Overlap is the intersection of NCCL and non-NCCL GPU-kernel interval unions in one rank0 trace
Observed overlap is not a controlled prefetch-off/on causal ablation
